Definition: from a compound of G4862 and G3129; a co-learner (of Christianity):--fellow disciple.
BiblicalUsage: When Jesus says He is going back to Judea where the Jews sought to stone Him, Thomas says to his fellow disciples, Let us also go, that we may die with Him. A fellow disciple is one who goes with Christ even when going looks like dying.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Thomas got this one exactly right, and I believe following Jesus means going with Him whether the road looks safe or not.
